title: Frame note
description: What a local vision model saw on one masked keyframe (ADR 0007). Stored as an event of kind 'frame' in the day store. Text fields are masked before storage.

ts.description: ms since epoch of the keyframe

frameId.description: id of the encrypted keyframe blob (frames/YYYY-MM-DD/<frameId>.enc)

activity.description: one plain sentence: what the user is doing, e.g. 'Reviewing a candidate CV against a job spec'

object.description: the thing worked on: invoice, CV, ticket, lead row, email

counterpart.description: person or organisation involved, masked if personal

surface.description: screen or view: 'Gmail compose', 'Xero bills list', 'Greenhouse candidate page'

step.description: where in a process: 'copying amount from PDF into form'

inputs.description: information read from the screen to do the step

outputs.description: what the step produced or changed

identifiers.description: stable ids seen: invoice no., ticket id, domain, file name (masked)
